\begin{tikzpicture}

\node[card] (a) {\heading{1}{独立な固有値組を補間で選ぶ}{Select an independent tuple by interpolation}
$A_0=p(A_1,\ldots,A_r),\quad p(\lambda)=1,\quad p(\mu)=0\ (\mu\ne\lambda)$\\
\Tx{同時上三角化を用い、半単純性は仮定しない}{Use simultaneous triangularization; no semisimplicity is assumed.}};
\node[card,below=2.6cm of a] (b) {\heading{2}{共役に不変な交代トレース}{A conjugation-invariant alternating trace}
$\displaystyle \Theta=\sum_{\pi\in\mathfrak S_r}\mathrm{sgn}(\pi)\mathrm{Tr}(A_0\,dA_{\pi(1)}\cdots dA_{\pi(r)})$\\
$\Theta=r!m_\lambda\,d\lambda_1\wedge\cdots\wedge d\lambda_r\ne0$};
\flow{a}{b}{\Tx{基底の微分の交換子項を、置換の対で相殺する。}{Pair permutations to cancel commutators from the differentiated basis.}\\$[A_j,B_\ell]=[A_\ell,B_j]$\\\Cite{trace-interpolation}};
\node[card,below=2.6cm of b] (c) {\heading{3}{固定基底で非零項を抽出}{Extract a nonzero term in the fixed basis}
$\omega_{\gamma_1}\wedge\cdots\wedge\omega_{\gamma_r}\ne0,
\qquad S_{\gamma_1}\cdots S_{\gamma_r}\ne0$\\
\Tx{次数ベクトル $\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_r$ は線形独立}{The degree vectors $\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_r$ are linearly independent.}};
\flow{b}{c}{\Tx{外積とトレースがともに非零の項を取る。}{Choose a term with both wedge and trace nonzero.}\\$\omega_\gamma=\sum_\ell\gamma_\ell\,dq_\ell/q_\ell$\\\Cite{inequality}};
\node[result,below=2.6cm of c] (d) {\heading{4}{余次元の減少量を数える}{Count the total codimension drop}
$S_\gamma(H_k)\subset H_{k+1-d_\gamma},\qquad
\displaystyle r(\iota-1)\le\sum_{j=1}^r(d_{\gamma_j}-1)\le n$};
\flow{c}{d}{\Tx{非零の積の総減少量は $H_0,\ldots,H_n$ の幅以下。}{A nonzero product cannot lower degree beyond $H_0,\ldots,H_n$.}\\\Cite{grading}};
